title: Poling
summary: PO'LING, noun In gardening, the operation of dispersing the worm-casts all over the walks, with long ash poles. This destroys the worm-casts and is beneficial to the walks. PO'LING, participle present

inlines.v: PO'LING, noun In gardening, the operation of dispersing the worm-casts all over the walks, with long ash poles. This destroys the worm-casts and is beneficial to the walks. PO'LING, participle present tense Furnishing with poles for support. 1. Bearing on poles. 2. Pushing forward with poles, as a boat.
